rationale: META has gapped down ~3% on elevated relative volume (3.66x) and is trading near the session low (6.4% of range), with price well below both VWAP ($666.36) and the 9-EMA ($675.87), indicating persistent selling pressure. However, the price is only 0.21% above the session low with a very tight range position, making both long and short entries high-risk: a long risks continuation of the downtrend with no clear support, while a short risks a sharp mean-reversion bounce from an oversold open. With no clear stabilization pattern in the last few candles and the broader market under pressure (SPY -0.86%, VIXY +2.07%), the risk/reward is insufficient to justify a new position at this moment.
